items.title: Latest cadre revision reveals shortage of 7,000 medical officers: Health Minister
items.summary: A newly completed cadre revision has identified a shortage of 7,000 medical officers across government hospitals islandwide, Health Minister Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa informed Parliament today.

items.title: Ranpokunugama residents yet to receive house ownership despite payments
items.summary: Ranpokunugama housing scheme residents have been deprived of ownership of their houses despite having made the required payments, Parliament was told today.

items.title: Leonid meteor shower to illuminate Sri Lankan skies tonight
items.summary: The Leonid meteor shower, described as the most significant meteor shower of the year, will be visible over Sri Lanka tonight (17), astronomer Gihan Weerasekara said.

items.title: Israel job portal opening on November 20
items.summary: The Sri Lanka Bureau of Foreign Employment (SLBFE) has warned the public against false social media reports claiming that an online job portal for employment in Israel will open on November 20.

items.title: Oil slips as recovering Mideast exports blunt Gulf tensions
items.summary: Oil prices fell on Tuesday as expectations of a supply surplus, driven by recovering Middle East exports, overshadowed concerns ​about continued attacks on tankers in the region and broader geopolitical tensions.
